name: austin_recent_intakes
description: Recent animal intakes at the Austin Animal Center (Austin, TX) — dogs, cats, and other animals arriving at the shelter. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "how many dogs did Austin Animal Center take in [last month/this week]", "recent Austin animal shelter intakes", "stray dogs Austin". Data refreshed hourly, live since May 2025 (ShelterBuddy system). Returns rows plus a total count for the window. Filter by animal_type (Dog, Cat, Kitten, Puppy, ...) and/or intake_type (Stray, Owner Surrender, ACO - Impound, ...).

days.description: How many days back from today to include (1-365, default 30 — i.e. "last month").

animal_type.description: Optional filter, e.g. "Dog", "Cat", "Kitten", "Puppy", "Rabbit". Case-sensitive exact match.

intake_type.description: Optional filter on how the animal arrived, e.g. "Stray", "Owner Surrender", "ACO - Impound". Case-sensitive exact match.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1-1000, default 50). The response also includes a separate total count for the window.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: austin_search_animal
description: Look up a specific animal at the Austin Animal Center by its animal ID, name, or breed, across both current intake and outcome records. Use for "what happened to animal A12345" or "is there a [breed] at Austin Animal Center".

animal_id.description: Exact Austin Animal Center animal ID, e.g. "A12345".

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: austin_outcomes_summary
description: Summary counts of Austin Animal Center outcomes (adopted, transferred, reclaimed, euthanized, etc.) grouped by outcome type, animal type, or month. Use for "how many animals were adopted from Austin Animal Center", "Austin shelter euthanasia rate".

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — only count outcomes on/after this date. Omit for all available current-system data (since May 2025).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.
